member.name: T:OpenBurnBar.Particles.Drawing.ISubstrateDrawingSession
member.summary:
Abstract per-frame drawing surface the substrate painters draw into. This is the seam that keeps the parity-critical painter logic platform-agnostic:
On Windows, Win2DSubstrateDrawingSession forwards each call to a Win2D CanvasDrawingSession (FillCircle, CanvasBlend.Add, CanvasRadialGradientBrush, GaussianBlurEffect).
Headless (macOS CI / perf harness), RecordingDrawingSession counts commands and hashes geometry, so the painter's CPU cost and its draw-command output are measurable and golden-testable without a GPU.
The method surface deliberately mirrors the subset of CanvasDrawingSession that the Swift GraphicsContext painters use, so the Win2D adapter is a nearly 1:1 forward.

member.name: T:OpenBurnBar.Particles.Drawing.RecordingDrawingSession
member.summary:
Headless that records draw commands instead of rasterizing them. Two jobs:
Perf harness: it does the minimum bookkeeping per call, so a frame's measured wall-time is the painter's CPU cost — particle iteration + draw-command emission (the parity-critical, ARM64-sensitive work) — not GPU rasterization (which is Windows-only and measured separately in CI).
Parity golden: with on it folds every command into an order-sensitive FNV-1a checksum, so a Mac↔Windows render of the same can be compared command-for-command without pixels.

member.name: T:OpenBurnBar.Particles.Substrates.DustMotesSubstrate
member.summary: Dust Motes — "Motes In The Beam", faithful C# port of Swift Views/Substrate/Volumetric/DustMotesSubstrate.swift (port of imaginethat volumetric/dust-motes.ts). The mark rendered as suspended dust drifting in still air, made visible only where one wide diagonal GAUSSIAN BEAM rakes across the cloud. Each point is a tiny soft radial MOTE tinted across a 24-step accent→accent2 altitude ramp (biased toward white so motes read sun-caught).
member.remarks: A mote's brightness is its dim ambient base PLUS a flare wherever the swept beam passes over its projected diagonal axis. ~38% are spring-locked cores that DON'T drift and hold a floored alpha; free dust drifts on a 2-octave value-noise flow field + Brownian micro-wander, leashed to radius·0.05. The beam center sweeps on sin(t·0.045); a 1.8s breath inhales its width; ~10% "lit specks" catch a thin additive 4-point cross glint. DARK: soft ink radial backing + additive motes; LIGHT: no ink, lower-alpha cooler motes. The whole-canvas god-ray band is one laid perpendicular to the beam axis. reduced freezes a poised raked still frame (no drift); batteryThrottled locks drift + drops the cross sparkles + Gaussian bloom.

member.summary: Dendritic Frost — faithful C# port of Swift Views/Substrate/Constellation/RimefrostSubstrate.swift (port of imaginethat constellation/rimefrost.ts, held "melt 0" look). Each silhouette point nucleates a six-armed rime crystal, drawn in depth-ordered passes so it reads as luminous frost spreading across cold glass.
member.remarks: (0) DARK deep Gaussian under-wash — every crystal's own brand color, lightly iced, filled additively into one blurred layer so each cluster glows in its hue. (1) icy BODY bloom — a cached white-blue frost radial per crystal, tinted to the dot's brand color (via 's tint), with a smaller untinted white-blue sheen cap on top. (2) SIX dendrite arms — 3 tapering spines + two forward side-branches each, batched per alpha-bin × width-group into a handful of line batches. (3) hot frozen CORE. (4) near-white frost GLINT cross on the brightest seeds (dark). Crystals grow & melt on a slow sin(0.5·t + seed·τ + posPhase) wave under an imperceptible global rotation (t·0.03). reduced holds a poised grown frost-field; batteryThrottled drops only the heaviest under-wash pass.

member.name: T:OpenBurnBar.Particles.Substrates.StarfireSubstrate
member.summary: Stellar Plasma — faithful C# port of Swift Views/Substrate/Constellation/StarfireSubstrate.swift (itself a port of imaginethat constellation/starfire.ts drawBody). The flagship Constellation bespoke painter, proving the full Win2D idiom set: additive () compositing, a Gaussian-blurred under-glow layer, cached radial glow sprites, chromatic plasma discs, near-white hot cores, and batched diffraction-cross strokes.
member.remarks: Each silhouette point is a long-exposure star. On a DARK canvas (additive) every point stacks, in z-order: (0) a deep Gaussian-blurred under-glow wash; (1) a cached white radial-glow bloom; (2) a chromatic plasma disc in the point's own color; (3) a near-white hot core (the legible silhouette point); (4) for the brightest ~20% (seed > 0.8) a slowly-rotating pure-white diffraction cross. On a LIGHT canvas it collapses to a soft colored halo + colored core. Twinkle is brightness/size only — no positional drift — driven purely from frame.T + a per-point seed, with an occasional sharp scintillation flare. reduced freezes to a poised still star-field; batteryThrottled drops the bloom + cross passes. The exact alpha/radius constants ARE the look — they match the Swift original line-for-line.

Each gem spins its facet-light assignment on t·0.6·(0.7+seed·0.6); the whole-cloud key drifts on sin(t·0.11). reduced freezes a poised jewel-case; batteryThrottled drops the bloom-under layer + asterism. The exact alpha/shade constants ARE the look — line-for-line with the Swift original.
